title: Monolithus
description:
Enter the mystical world of the Monolith and explore all the possibilities to reach its goal through the different onirical locations.

 You should reach the Blue Box having any other box enlightened in order to pass the level. The Monolith can move vertically by one grid and horizontally by three.

 

 Every box can be enlightened or turned off when the Monolith lays over.

                                                       CHARACTERISTICS:

•  UNIQUE CHARM

 

The differents maps, sound effects, and music will induce you in a relaxing mood. Incredibly enjoyable graphics will help you exploring your way out of each level through all stages.

•  UNIQUE MOVEMENT MECHANICS

 The movement mechanic differs from other grid-based movement mechanics. While the Monolith is standing, it will move to whatever direction laying horizontally over three grids, and viceversa moving one grid vertically.

•  VARIOUS OBSTACLES

 Each level you will find new obstacles to overcome, these different dificulties will put you to the test, where not only mastering the movement mechanic is important, you should plan each movement since the very beginning not to fail.

•  +40 LEVELS

 With 40 initial levels, adding new maps with new obstacles in future updates and seasons completely free.
description_short: Play a slow paced puzzle. A charm and onirical ambience will help you focus to find your way trough various levels and discover all the cubes that offers new mechanics overtime.
